test_title: PYST 62: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 15th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A money lender finds that due to a fall in the annual rate of interest from 10% to 8(3)/(4)%, his year's income diminishes by Rs. 84.50. Find his capital.
solution:
**Given:**

Initial Rate(R₁) = 10%

Final Rate(R₂) = 8{3over4}% = {35over 4} %

**Formula used:**

Diminishing Income** = (Ptimes R₁ times T)/(100) - (Ptimes R₂times T )/(100) **

**Calculation:**

R₁ = 10%

R₂ = 8{3over4} % = {35over 4} %

The difference in Simple Interest = Rs. 84.50

Rightarrow(Ptimes R₁ times T)/(100) - (Ptimes R₂times T )/(100)=84.50 

Rightarrow(Ptimes 10 times 1)/(100) - (Ptimes 8.75times 1 )/(100)=84.50 

P = Rs. 6760

Hence,

Capital is Rs. 6760.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

⇒ 10\%-8.75\% = 84.50

⇒ 1.25\%=84.50 

**⇒ 100% = 6760.**
